thread:
emma: Heads-up — want to intake a new community model for a Dedicated pilot: orionx-12b (weights from lumify.ai). License attached says "research-only; no commercial use". Can we run quant experiments and evals while legal clarifies?
rajiv: Sounds useful for latency/quality tradeoffs. Quick q: do we have the raw license text? paste please.
emma: pasted snippet from their repo: ```No commercial use. Redistribution prohibited. Derivative works allowed with attribution. Model trained on mixed web and licensed corpora.```
sara_legal: Flag: "No commercial use" will block any paid/hosted usage and Dedicated customer deployments unless we get a commercial grant. Also need provenance for training data (PII/nonconsensual scraping). Please ping upstream for a commercial license and dataset disclosures.
marco: From infra: quantization/bringup feasible but we need canonical weight format. Do they publish HF-style sharded .bin or a custom bundle? Also request a checksum: `sha256` for transfer integrity.
emma: They have a weights URL and a small metadata.json. I saved it to internal bucket (s3://redwood-intake/orionx-12b/). I ran a quick 8-bit inference smoke test on cpu — responses look coherent. Planning 4-bit q experiments next.
rajiv: Proposed eval plan (short): 1) offline perplexity vs zephyr-7b baseline on heldout; 2) chat-quality eval (10 prompt suite); 3) safety/regression checks (policy-sensitive prompts); 4) embedding drift vs current embed model. Can start local runs.
sara_legal: Also add export-control check (country of origin + contributors). If model or training infra includes restricted tech, we may need export review. I'll open a legal intake and loop in compliance.
infra-bot: Automated scan: license=non-commercial, weights_hash=unknown, telemetry_flag=none. Recommended action: HOLD for commercial use; allow local evals in isolated VPC.
marco: For quant flow, here's the minimal commands we suggest to team: ```python -m pip install orionx-utils
orionx-utils fetch --url <weights-url> --dest /mnt/models/orionx-12b
orionx-utils quantize --model /mnt/models/orionx-12b --bits 4 --out /mnt/models/orionx-12b-4bit``` Note: run on isolated infra and don't upload to hosted buckets until legal clears.
emma: Plan: I'll start the 4-bit q runs on dev-gpu-2 (isolated) tonight, collect eval metrics, and simultaneously email lumify.ai sales for commercial terms and dataset manifest. Will tag here when I have answers.
rajiv: If legal delays, we can still run local A/B quality checks but keep any artifacts private and no customer-facing deployments.
sara_legal: Exactly. Also prepare a short summary for the license review: intended use, traffic estimates, retention, derivative publishing plans. I'll draft a checklist and share.
emma: Ack — will compile eval notebook + traffic estimates and drop in the intake ticket. Thanks. :thumbsup:
marco: One more infra note — set a canary rollout plan: 5% traffic on a dedicated pool, with auto-fallback to zephyr-7b and circuit-breaker at 5% error spike. I'll draft the runtime config once legal greenlights.
infra-bot: Action recorded: intake-ticket #INT-2026-459 created, legal-review assigned to sara_legal, infra assignee marco.
emma: Great, closing for now. Will update in thread when upstream replies. :eyes:
